name: Standing Band Leg Press
description: Leg strength and hip and knee mobility: with the band under one foot, lift the knee, then press the foot back down into the band.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Put the middle of the band under the middle of your right foot.
Hold both ends tight in front of you at waist height.
cues: Keep the band under your foot as the knee comes up.
Easier: hold the ends lower, closer to your feet.
Hold a wall or chair if you feel wobbly.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Lift the knee
keyframes.cue: Raise your right knee, keeping the band under your foot.

keyframes.name: Press down
keyframes.cue: Push your foot down into the band and back to the floor.
